questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Naypyidaw?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Myanmar is Naypyidaw.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Myanmar about 676,577 square kilometres; Malaysia about 330,803 square kilometres; Kyrgyzstan about 199,951 square kilometres; Latvia about 64,594 square kilometres.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Myanmar on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Myanmar on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Myanmar?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Myanmar on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Myanmar article.

questions.proof: It is bordered by China on the north, Laos on the east, Thailand on the southeast, Bangladesh on the west, and India on the northwest, with the Andaman Sea to the south, and the Bay of Bengal to the southwest.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Myanmar?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Myanmar article.

questions.proof: Its capital city is Naypyidaw and its largest city is Yangon.
